name: @kattebak/typespec-enum-emitter
description: TypeSpec emitter for JavaScript const enums

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test:emit && npm run test:output
scripts.test:emit: tsp compile test/main.tsp --config test/tspconfig.yaml && tsp compile test/stdlib/main.tsp --config test/stdlib/tspconfig.yaml && tsp compile test/stdlib/main.tsp --config test/stdlib/tspconfig.exclude.yaml
